scraped.scraped_description: Large-scale discussions between many participants abound on the internet today. But as these discussions grow to tens of thousands of posts, they become ever more difficult for a reader to digest.

name: Wikum
tagline: Tools for communities to collectively summarize large online discussions and manage embedded knowledge
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Limited ongoing maintenance; last commit in 2017 suggests project may not be actively developed
academic_citations: Zhang, Amy X. and Verou, Lea and Karger, David. Wikum: Bridging Discussion Forums and Wikis Using Recursive Summarization. CSCW 2017
published_performance_metrics: User studies conducted in CSCW 2017 publication
documented_limitations: Research paper documents limitations of recursive summarization approach
failure_modes: Potential challenges in scaling collective summarization; dependency on community participation
contributor_governance: Academic research project governance through MIT CSAIL
